settings.text: Office anti-fatigue mats provide an excellent layer of protection against cold hard floors, while keeping you healthier, more comfortable, energized, and more productive.

settings.subtitle: flagship product
settings.title: Comfort-series
settings.text:
Say goodbye to aches and pains from standing for hours. Comfort Series Anti-Fatigue Mats are made from a tear resistant polyurethane foam that's comfortable underfoot.

  • Firm foam for optimal support
  • Creates a cushioned barrier against hard flooring
  • Reduces strain on lower body

settings.title: SUPREME PUZZLE BUSINESS MATS
settings.text: Dictate the length, width, and shape of your anti-fatigue mat. The interlocking 'puzzle' edges provide effortless assembly and can be easily dismantled for rearranging and cleaning.

settings.title: SMARTSTEP BUSINESS ANTI-FATIGUE MATS
settings.text: Ideal for workspaces and business offices. These mats provide unrivaled comfort, support and relief to all those who stand on it and have been known to relieve foot and back pains.

settings.title: RHINO HIDE ANTI-FATIGUE MAT
settings.text: Resistance to punctures from heels, cart traffic, tears, cuts, and is over three times more abrasion resistant than competing products. Ideal for harsher environments with high traffic.

settings.title: SOFTWOODS ANTI-FATIGUE MATS
settings.text: Soft Woods Anti-Fatigue Mat combines an attractive wood-grain finish with the comfort of high quality soft foam to produce a mat that is as good looking as it is comfortable.

settings.title: Companion Anti-fatigue Mats
settings.text: Designed to be carried off to any place you would need an anti-fatigue mat whether it is household chores, landscaping and gardening, enjoying oneself in a stadium or a show. These companion mats are small enough to fit in a suitcase so they are ideal for travelling.
